shortDescription: Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value, was down by 3.57% to $56,813.68 at 10:50 p.m. ET on Friday (0350 GMT on Saturday).Earlier on Friday it fell below $60,000 for the first time since July, as lofty valuation concerns weighed on the AI trade and other risk assets.
